package.name: burgerbot_dialog
package.description:
Conversation with a local language model, in text.
The model produces intent and nothing else. What it says goes out as text; the face it asks for is a bid to the mood arbiter, the gesture it asks for goes through the gesture server's lidar feasibility gate, and a place it asks to go to is resolved to a pose and handed to burgerbot_companion, which owns the Nav2 client. So a model that hallucinates cannot produce a velocity command, and every arbitration and safety layer that already existed still applies.
All of the judgement is in modules with no ROS import and pytest coverage: schema.py validates whatever the model returned and degrades per field rather than per reply, conversation.py owns turn-taking and what happens when the model is slow or dead, places.py resolves a spoken place name, prompt.py assembles the context. The node does topics, actions and threads.
Text only. There is no microphone or speaker on this robot, and building against a keyboard first is how a prompt gets tuned in milliseconds instead of seconds.
